headline: Healthy Growth, but Margin Recovery Remains Gradual

highlights: Key Points  DOMS’ Q2FY27 consolidated revenue grew 17.6% YoY to Rs6,678mn, in line with our Rs6,701mn estimate (-0.4%) and broadly flat QoQ.
Over ~80% of the 18% H1FY27 growth was volume aided by capacity additions and new launches.

Heavy- rainfall flooding at a Gujarat warehouse cost an estimated 300-350bps of Q2 sales growth.  GM improved by 92bps QoQ to 39.1%, marginally ahead of estimates, as the consumption cost impact eased to ~9% from ~11% in Q1.
Gross profit grew 4.9% YoY to Rs2,609mn.  EBITDA stood at Rs828mn (-16.8% YoY), with margin at 12.4% (vs 12.3% in Q1).
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: The margin squeeze is a transitory, management-chosen trade-off (volume and share over near-term margin), not structural as seen in the gross margin already inflecting up.

Management reiterated its 18-20% FY27 revenue guidance and stated its 16- 17% medium term EBITDA margin target but gave no recovery timeline, noting DOMS historically needs 18-24 months to capture an inflation cycle (two done).
Management targets rebuilding the ~Rs1,500mn revenue base over 9–12 months, while team integration remains a temporary 0.5–1% of sales drag.
